# GlobalGiving

> GlobalGiving is a global crowdfunding platform connecting individual and corporate donors with vetted grassroots nonprofit projects across 170+ countries.

Founded by Dennis Whittle and Mari Kuraishi, GlobalGiving enables donors to support charitable causes ranging from disaster relief to child welfare and community development. The platform serves both individual donors and corporate partners like 21st Century Fox and BlackRock, facilitating matched giving campaigns and direct project funding.

## Getting Started

- [GlobalGiving Homepage](https://www.globalgiving.org/): Main platform connecting donors with grassroots projects worldwide
- [About GlobalGiving](https://www.globalgiving.org/aboutus/): GlobalGiving mission, values, and overview of the nonprofit platform
- [Who We Are](https://www.globalgiving.org/aboutus/who-we-are/): GlobalGiving founders Dennis Whittle and Mari Kuraishi with organizational vision

## For Donors

- [How It Works](https://www.globalgiving.org/aboutus/how-it-works/): Explanation of GlobalGiving's vetting, matching, and fundraising process
- [Donate to Help End World Hunger and Save a Child's Life](https://www.globalgiving.org/microprojects/help-end-world-hunger-and-save-a-childs-life/donate/): Afrika Tikkun donation page for child hunger relief in South Africa
- [Teach Children About Charity](https://www.globalgiving.org/learn/teach-children-about-charity-resources/): Educational resources for teaching children about charity and giving

## For Nonprofits & Organizations

- [Nonprofits](https://www.globalgiving.org/nonprofits/): Nonprofit fundraising platform with donor connections and support tools

## Corporate & Campaign Resources

- [GlobalGiving - 21st Century Fox](https://www.globalgiving.org/21cf/): 21st Century Fox corporate giving campaign for disaster relief fundraising
- [Disaster Response Next Steps](https://www.globalgiving.org/disaster-relief-next-steps/): Guide for setting up disaster relief campaigns with matching terms
